description.value:
Rostović may not be considered a top-tier arms manufacturer, but their Kolac rifle is nothing to sneeze at. If you're shopping for reliable accuracy and dependable durability, look no further. And with such an affordable price tag, the Kolac feels like a steal. Unfortunately, ergonomics were not a top priority during development. While undeniably precise, this rifle feels heavy and unbalanced. From a quality of life standpoint, this is where Rostović falls behind competitors such as Arasaka, Kang Tao, Tsunami and Militech. Still, if it’s earned a spot with Serbia's armed forces, there's no reason to doubt its effectiveness on the streets of Night City.

Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Assault Rifle • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Marksman Rifle

Damage: 7d6, Drop 2 Lowest • Capacity: 6 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Reloading this weapon requires 2 Reload Actions. Requires BODY 11+, paired Cyberarms, or being Mounted to not reduce the user’s MOVE by 2 while wielded. A Nomad may choose to receive this weapon when they first install a Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount.

Range: Marksman Rifle
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 7d6, dropping the 2 lowest dice. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
